full_judgment: 7. Mr. K.A. Bakr, Counsel for the defendant appellant, submitted that since the suit land is agricultural land the provisions of the Bengal Tenancy Act would apply in case of transfer of the land, section 26C which was inserted by way of amendment in 1928 being prior to the transfer of the suit land in favour of the plaintiff will govern the transfer. No exception to its applicability Can be taken by mentioning that the transfer concerned being by an oral gift is not covered by the word 'transfer'. The expressions used in section 26C include every transfer excepting a bequest or a sale in execution of a decree or of a certificate signed under the Bengal Public Demands Recovery Act, 1913. An oral gift comes within the ambit and scope of "every transfer" mentioned in the section. After the enactment of the State Acquisition and.
